objective: Develop the standalone Chinese asset-delivery workbench from 1.0 into a production-ready 1.1 with visual project Profile authoring, deeper deterministic delivery rules, reproducible real-world demos, Windows distribution and public release evidence.

milestones.outcome: Ship the read-only audit MVP and its safety evidence.
Harden report interoperability and large-delivery behavior.
Provide reproducible production-like demo assets and a complete recording tutorial.
Ship the interactive read-only delivery review workbench.
Ship safe organization, project history and public GitHub release evidence.
Let users create, validate, save and reuse versioned project Profiles without editing JSON.
Add evidence-backed deterministic rules for realistic delivery structure and texture sets.
Ship a verified Windows distribution and public 1.1 release evidence.

nextSlice.outcome: Implement the versioned Profile authoring core and a Chinese desktop Profile workspace that can create from presets, import, edit, validate and safely save reusable project rules.
nonGoals: Modify audited delivery files while editing a Profile
Build Maya or Unreal scene adapters
Build cloud accounts, permissions or project management
acceptance: A user can create a Profile from a documented preset without editing JSON
Existing strict art-delivery-profile/1 files can be imported, edited, validated and saved outside the delivery root
Invalid rule parameters and duplicate rule activations produce clear Chinese field-level errors and cannot be saved
Changing the active Profile invalidates stale audit and organization state and requires a new scan
Profile core behavior is testable without PySide6 and remains compatible with CLI audit loading
Success, invalid input, safe-save rejection and narrow-window states have deterministic tests and actual Chinese UI screenshots
README, user guide, demo instructions and capability evidence describe only verified behavior

guardrails: Chinese UI, README, tutorials and screenshot captions are the default deliverables
Never mutate immutable demo/scenarios fixtures; organization demos operate on generated work copies
Demo assets are synthetic or license-audited and redistributable
Every showcase release includes multiple actual-run screenshots covering success, failure, boundary and before/after states
Mutation requires dry-run, collision checks, explicit confirmation, rollback and post-run verification
Material networks and DCC scene adapters remain out of scope until separately justified
